name: Deathless
source:
You play as a broken man who has given up on life after a tragic event. Now the only thing he wants is to forget, forget it all, so he can keep living.
In search of peace, he left everything behind to start a new life. A life on the streets alongside his one and only friend, Valerie.
Can he find peace and escape his demons? It's all in your hands.

[From [url=https://seacth.itch.io/deathless]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个在悲惨事件后放弃生活的破碎的人。现在他唯一想要的就是忘记，忘记一切，这样他才能继续活下去。
为了寻求平静，他抛开了一切，开始了新的生活。与他唯一的朋友瓦莱丽一起过着街头生活。
他能找到平静并逃离内心的恶魔吗？一切都在你的手中。

[来自[url=https://seacth.itch.io/deathless]Itch.io[/url]]
